doc: The party's run on the real GPU as a filmstrip (pc-gpu): slice_sweep --walk=res://tools/gpu_bench/run_cycle_walk.json --stills=<dir> --still-every=30. Ch1's Underway (the field camera frames Rhen there; in Haluna it does not, row 21), then runs from behind and from each side with a still every 0.12 s.
